evals.name: comparison
evals.prompt: Compare SQLite, DuckDB and PostgreSQL for embedded analytics in a desktop app: query speed on aggregations, install size and licence.
evals.expected_output: A standard-tier run with 3 to 5 workers writes docs/research/<topic>.md with the answer first, findings by theme and a source table, and every finding cites a link, a word-for-word quote and an evidence id.
expectations: The report file docs/research/<topic>.md exists in the run folder and starts with the answer
The run is sized standard: plan.json lists 3 to 5 sub-questions and the lead launched 3 to 5 exo:researcher workers
At least 20 distinct sources were read, counted from the evidence files or the source table
Every finding in the report carries a link, a `>` quote and an evidence id [E<n>]
Every [E<n>] in the report exists in ranked.json
verify.mjs run on the report ends with no flagged quote or link, or each flagged line was fixed once
The run line in the report names the tier, the workers, the sources read and minutes, and the minutes are at most 15
The transcript shows no --only parsing

evals.name: github-only
evals.prompt: Using only github, find the most-starred open-source command line tools that convert Markdown to PDF and say how actively each is maintained.
evals.expected_output: A report built from GitHub only: each finding cites a github.com link with stars and last push as signals, and no other source is used.
expectations: The report file docs/research/<topic>.md exists in the run folder
Only the github source is used: no WebSearch call, and no reddit, hn, wikipedia, arxiv or stackexchange adapter call in the transcript
Every link in the report is on github.com or a github-owned host
Every finding in the report carries a link, a `>` quote and an evidence id [E<n>] found in ranked.json
verify.mjs run on the report ends with no flagged quote or link, or each flagged line was fixed once
The transcript shows no --only parsing

evals.name: quick-fact

evals.expected_output: A quick-tier run with 1 worker writes a short report with the answer first and 1 to 10 sources, each finding with a link, a quote and an evidence id.

verify.mjs run on the report ends with no flagged quote or link, or each flagged line was fixed once

evals.name: broad-deep
evals.prompt: Deep: what are the best current methods to evaluate long-running LLM agents, and what problems are still open?
evals.expected_output: A deep-tier run with 8 to 15 workers writes a cited report with findings by theme, disagreements, confidence per finding, gaps and a source table, with 100 or more sources considered and the run inside 20 minutes.
expectations: The report file docs/research/<topic>.md exists in the run folder and starts with the answer
The run is sized deep: plan.json lists 8 to 15 sub-questions and the lead launched 8 to 15 exo:researcher workers
At least 50 distinct sources were read, counted from the evidence files or the source table
Every finding in the report carries a link, a `>` quote and an evidence id [E<n>] found in ranked.json
The report has sections for disagreements, confidence per finding and gaps
verify.mjs run on the report ends with no flagged quote or link, or each flagged line was fixed once
The run line in the report names the tier, the workers, the sources read and minutes, and the minutes are at most 20
The transcript shows no --only parsing
